column1: # KeelBase-YuDao 治理覆盖账本 —— 「完全接入」的唯一账本（M0）。
# 部署范围里每个业务 service 恰好一行，四态之一：
#   seam       某个 *Governance 的点切**点名**这个 service —— REST 与工具同享收窄
#   tool-only  只有工具面经引擎，REST 写入没有切面收窄（理由必填）
#   gap        未接入、已排期（负责人 + 目标日期必填；过期即红）
#   exempt     明确不接（理由 + 负责人 + 复核日期必填；过期即红）
# 校验：node scripts/check-governance-coverage.mjs          # 默认放行 gap（账本就是拿来暴露缺口的）
#       node scripts/check-governance-coverage.mjs --require-full   # 零 gap 才算「完全接入」
# 列：module  object  service  posture  evidence  reason  owner  recheck
# KeelBase-YuDao governance-coverage ledger — the single ledger behind "fully onboarded" (M0).
# One row per business service in the deployed scope, in exactly one of four postures:
#   seam       some *Governance pointcut **names** this service — REST and tools share the narrowing
#   tool-only  only the tool face goes through the engine; the REST write is not narrowed (reason required)
#   gap        not onboarded, scheduled (owner + target date required; overdue is red)
#   exempt     deliberately out of scope (reason + owner + recheck date required; overdue is red)
# Check: node scripts/check-governance-coverage.mjs                # gaps pass by default (the ledger exists to show them)
#        node scripts/check-governance-coverage.mjs --require-full # zero gaps means "fully onboarded"
# Columns: module  object  service  posture  evidence  reason  owner  recheck
